hits.snippet: # BDR names Ryan Farris as new Chief Executive Officer July 14, 2026 Ryan Farris PR _Founder Bruce Wiseman to move into role of executive chairman role as company strengthens its leadership team for long-term growth._ * * * SEATTLE – July 14, 2026 – Business Development Resources (BDR), the premier provider of business coaching, training and marketing services for home service contractors across North America, announces the appointment of Ryan Farris as chief executive officer, effective today. BDR founder Bruce Wiseman will remain with the company, transitioning into the role of Executive Chairman. “One of the most important responsibilities of any founder is ensuring the organization is positioned for long-term success,” said Wiseman. “After an extensive search process, I am confident we found the right leader in Ryan. Founder Bruce Wiseman will transition to executive chairman. Farris brings over 30 years of leadership experience across entrepreneurship, technology and business operations. He previously founded and exited his own company before spending the past decade coaching entrepreneurs and small business owners. Founded in 1998, BDR supports home services contractors with business coaching, marketing and training solutions. The company serves over 900 contractor businesses across North America and hosts training events for more than 10,000 businesses annually.
